The '''A4 laboratory assistant droid''' was a model of [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]], modified from their [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]]. It specialized in [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]], prostheses, and other types of implants. [[EV-A4-D/Legends|EV-A4-D]], the [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], was an A4 laboratory assistant droid.

==Characteristics==
[[File:AseriesAtWork-GAW.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An A4 laboratory assistant droid at work]]
A [[Class one droid/Legends|class one droid]],<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> the A4 laboratory assistant [[Droid/Legends|droid]]<ref name="A-4D (Ayfour-Dee)" /> was a model of [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]]<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> modified from the [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]].<ref name="A4-Series Lab Droid" /> An extremely efficient model, the A4-series specialized in [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] prosthetics and other biomechanical implants and served as surgical aides for cybernetic implant procedures. Though equipped with [[Heuristic processor/Legends|heuristic processors]], they were not programmed for decision making.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==History==
Manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]],<ref name="A-4D (Ayfour-Dee)" /> the A4 laboratory assistant droid proved so good at its tasks that [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]] upgraded them from surgical assistants to chief surgical droids. When placed in their new roles, the droids did not object and went about their jobs. However, as they evaluated their new roles, the A4-series concluded that biological parts were inferior to cybernetic implants. As a result, patients across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] awoke from surgery with healthy appendages unnecessarily replaced with prostheses. The A4-series was quickly identified as the culprits, and the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] banned its further sale and ordered all existing units destroyed, giving it the dubious distinction of being one of the only medical droid models outlawed by the body. Despite this, MerenData never issued a formal recall, leaving many A4 owners ignorant of the edict and of the potential danger of giving them decision-making responsibility and allowing them to continue serving throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
